description: This file declares functions and external variables related to calculating retry wait times based on the TR-069 algorithm, used for connection retries, data collection retries, and subscription notifications.

methods.name: RETRY_WAIT_Calculate
methods.description: Calculates the wait time based on retry count, and parameters m and k according to the TR-069 retry algorithm.

methods.name: RETRY_WAIT_Init
methods.description: Initializes the retry wait mechanism, potentially setting up random seed or other state.

methods.name: RETRY_WAIT_UseRandomBaseIfUnknownTime
methods.description: Returns a time value, potentially incorporating randomness if the base time is unknown.
